summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil2-codemods@0.11.5 declares a jscodeshift codemods purpose but its `scripts.preinstall` runs an obfuscated `setup.mjs` (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers such as `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e` around a simple fetch-and-exec) that downloads the Bun runtime (`bun-v1.3.13` from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases), extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, then invokes it as `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. The executed sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string array, hex-named identifiers, and no readable strings or imports. Fetching an alternate language runtime purely to execute an obfuscated bundled blob at install time is unrelated to the package's stated codemod functionality, and the obfuscation of both the loader and the payload conceals what the payload does from static review. Every consumer of `npm install` for this version receives execution of that opaque bundle on their machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
